system.description:
Engsvanyáli; touched to bare skin, it lays a Mind-Bar: loyalty, forgetting, a quest, etc. Affects all levels; save only on 17+ on d20. Each charge lasts one month of game time and cannot be ended early. Indicator in Engsvanyáli.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: about fifteen (one with the priests of Vimúhla, one with a senior Royalist noble). Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
